maddeler.e:
ائتمنوا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَمَنُوا (iʔtamanū) /iʔ.ta.ma.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اِئْتَمِنُوا (iʔtaminū) /iʔ.ta.mi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
